open.text: Every day, people face emergencies they were never trained for. A heart stops. A deep cut. An earthquake.

view.text: With AI glasses, the dispatcher sees exactly what you see, and a voice guides you, step by step, hands-free.

scope.text: Cardiac arrest, severe bleeding, choking, an earthquake, a flood: one guide for any emergency.

case.text: Here is one case we built end to end: a cardiac arrest.
